headings: Coastal Cold-Chain & Reefer Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
2. Dwell Fee & Power Surcharge Billing Formula
summary_bullets: - **Pharmaceuticals (Class P):** Maintain strictly between **2°C and 8°C**. Any deviation exceeding ±1.5°C for more than 20 minutes triggers a Critical Excursion Alert.
- **Frozen Seafood (Class F):** Maintain at or below **-18°C**. Temperature rising above -15°C for more than 45 minutes requires immediate reefer unit inspection.
- **Chilled Produce (Class C):** Maintain between **0°C and 4°C** with relative humidity set to 85–90%.

documents.title: HAZARDOUS CARGO EXCEPTIONS & BROWNOUT PRIORITY RULES
headings: HAZARDOUS CARGO EXCEPTIONS & BROWNOUT PRIORITY RULES
summary_bullets: HAZARDOUS CARGO EXCEPTIONS & BROWNOUT PRIORITY RULES
1. IMDG Segregation Near Reefer Power Banks:
- Containers carrying IMDG Class 2.1 (Flammable Gases) or Class 3 (Flammable Liquids) must maintain at least 6 meters horizontal segregation from energized 440V reefer power racks.

documents.title: Reefer Pre-Trip Inspection (PTI) & Compliance Checklist
summary_bullets: - Every empty reefer container must pass a full Pre-Trip Inspection (PTI) within 7 days prior to gate-out for cold-chain loading.
- Inspect condenser coils, evaporator fan amperage, door gasket seal integrity, and fresh-air vent closure.
- Supply and return air temperature probes must be calibrated every **6 months** using a certified reference thermometer with accuracy within ±0.2°C.
